note: Live-check scope for operating.case_mail (live check ``case.mail_evidence``): the six operational mailboxes where a purchase order's mail lives, as in scope them (owner 2026-10-21): order-confirmation@ (the supplier's confirmation), ship@ and torontowh@ (freight, shipping and the Toronto warehouse), ap@ (the supplier's invoice), receiving@ and qclabresults@ (receiving and QC lab results); order@, ordersupport@, purchase-order@ and qcrequests@ had no mail in 30 days and sales@ and quotes@ do not exist. All are allowlisted in operating/case_mail_scope.json. Inbox only; captures stay in the Workbench capture store under the check's temporary state directory. The checks bound delta pages per folder with --capture-page-budget, so a large folder stops incomplete (reason page_budget), never silently complete. Excluded people (integrations/people_exclusion.py) are refused before any request. Configuration, never a grant: the capture principal still needs the live-source audience and the Exchange application access policy still applies upstream. Read-only.
